svg.text: CODE Test | 826 paired ECGs | Pointwise 95% bootstrap CI (1,000 resamples)
B Calibration: predicted versus observed probability
Calibration lines are PCHIP interpolation through observed quantile-bin means only; no extrapolation or recalibration. Histograms show score distributions.
AUROC confidence intervals and Brier scores are computed from original predictions, not from interpolated curves.
